notes: Backend batch item 3. Adds GET /v1/campaigns/:id/production (brand-only, ownership-scoped in the WHERE clause) returning the campaign's active-creator roster with contract + production_events state (mode/status, visit address/schedule/contact, shipment address/courier/AWB/dates). Unblocks the inline visit-scheduling + shipment-dispatch actions deferred from web A5 step 1, where production state was readable only one contract at a time. Design calls: LEFT JOIN from campaign_influencers so creators without a contract/event yet appear with nulls rather than vanishing; status filtered to contracted/active/live/completed. Schema verified against migration 024 before writing the SELECT — no guessed columns. Route uses the same proven fall-through mount pattern as the existing /contracts/:id/production. NO MIGRATION. Ships UNCONSUMED by design — frontend wiring (web Production tab + mobile stage + inline actions) is a separate contract, so this cannot regress the UI. PRODUCTION-IMPACTING: push deploys Render.
